item.title: Two ways of being a developer in the age of AI
item.description: Generative AI is not killing the developer, it is changing the act of developing. A personal reflection on those who like the code, those who like the product, and why I move between the two.

item.title: Modernizing my master's dissertation with AI
item.description: A case study: I handed my master’s code (2011) to AI, cut the run time from minutes to seconds, made sure the results still held, and came away with a process and a future research topic.

item.title: From glorified Google to agent: why I resisted AI
item.description: From skepticism to daily use: what changed my mind about AI in software development, and what still went wrong along the way.
